nodes.description: External caller address; controls ownership assignment, balance keys in transfer/transferFrom/approveAndCall and allowance keys in approve/transferFrom.
Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership, then cleared.
Token symbol, set to "FSHN" in the constructor.
Token name, set to "FSHN" in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Pure helper returning a + b after an overflow require check.
Pure helper returning a - b after requiring b <= a.
Pure helper returning a * b with an overflow sanity check.
Pure helper returning a / b after requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor; assigns msg.sender to owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after requiring msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor; sets metadata, total supply and the initial balance.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using a raw unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning the balance of a given account.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from an approved account using the caller's allowance; emits Transfer.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets an allowance then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer() on an arbitrary token contract to recover tokens.
Integer addition a + b in safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Integer subtraction a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Integer multiplication a * b in safeMul, guarded by an overflow check.
Integer division a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply; can underflow if tokens are sent to address(0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) into an arbitrary token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
msg.sender is used as the balance mapping key in transfer, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
msg.sender is used as the outer key of allowed in approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before taking ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the transfer.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the decimals value.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed minted amount.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the deployer address in balances.
The initial balances entry is derived directly from _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the circulating supply computation.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow.
safeAdd executes the a + b addition operation.
safeSub executes the a - b subtraction operation.
safeMul executes the a * b multiplication operation.
safeDiv executes the a / b division operation.
Parameter a flows into safeAdd.
Parameter b flows into safeAdd.
Local c stores the safeAdd result.
Parameter a flows into safeSub.
Parameter b flows into safeSub.
Local c stores the safeSub result.
Parameter a flows into safeMul.
Parameter b flows into safeMul.
Local c stores the safeMul result.
Parameter a flows into safeDiv.
Parameter b flows into safeDiv.
Local c stores the safeDiv result.
tokenOwner is used as the balances mapping key in balanceOf.
balanceOf returns the balances entry selected by tokenOwner.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in transfer's safeSub call.
tokens parameter is the addend in transfer's safeAdd call.
to parameter indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the value written into allowed by approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
from parameter indexes the balances mapping in transferFrom.
to parameter indexes the balances mapping in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted in transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed inner mapping in allowance.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens before the external call.
spender parameter determines the target contract of the receiveApproval call.
tokens parameter is forwarded as an argument to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to receiveApproval.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of receiveApproval.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an arbitrary spender contract, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The callee invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall and other token functions.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary ERC20 contract being called.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The called token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external call.

Parameter b of safeSub only exists to feed the safeSub helper and should be folded into the safeSub function node.
Local c of safeSub is a temporary result holder and should be folded into the safeSub function node.
Parameter a of safeMul only exists to feed the safeMul helper and should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Parameter b of safeMul only exists to feed the safeMul helper and should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Local c of safeMul is a temporary result holder and should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Parameter a of safeDiv only exists to feed the safeDiv helper and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
Parameter b of safeDiv only exists to feed the safeDiv helper and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
Local c of safeDiv is a temporary result holder and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
_newOwner is the sole input of transferOwnership and normalizes into that function node.
tokenOwner is the sole input of balanceOf and normalizes into that function node.
The to parameter only feeds the transfer function's balance update and normalizes into transfer.
The tokens parameter only feeds the transfer function's balance arithmetic and normalizes into transfer.
The spender parameter only feeds the approve function's allowance write and normalizes into approve.
The tokens parameter only feeds the approve function's allowance write and normalizes into approve.
The from parameter only feeds the transferFrom balance update and normalizes into transferFrom.
The to parameter only feeds the transferFrom balance update and normalizes into transferFrom.
The tokens parameter only feeds the transferFrom arithmetic and normalizes into transferFrom.
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup key for allowance and normalizes into the allowance function node.
spender is a read-only lookup key for allowance and normalizes into the allowance function node.
The spender parameter of approveAndCall controls the callback target and normalizes into approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter of approveAndCall feeds both the allowance write and the callback and normalizes into approveAndCall.
The data parameter of approveAndCall is only forwarded to the callback and normalizes into approveAndCall.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary call target of transferAnyERC20Token and normalizes into that function node.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer and normalizes into transferAnyERC20Token.
